label: Long Jump
_note: SPEC_PET_ARENA §6.6 (Rev.8) — the first Tier-2 event: three run-up windows on a fixed clock, distance = charge × jump_conversion, best of three, ranked descending. distance_m here is the RUNUP length the lane draws, not a target to cover; power leads the weights, which is what makes the jumpers differ from the sprinters.
